title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.

features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Curing Vault

title: The Convergence of Tracks

The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: The Work-Ring
summary: The deepest chamber on this level. A wide circle of chalk glows on the cave floor — the same pale light as your own lines — and inside it, golems stand unfinished: a shoulder, a head with no seams yet, slabs of raw rock. The air is thick with ash and hot clay.
inspect_text: You stop at the edge of a wide chalk circle drawn on the cave floor, glowing the same pale light as the lines you draw yourself. At the ring’s center the goblin shaman works, hunched and patient, one pale hand pressed flat to the stone. Tock. Tock. A staff beating slow time against the floor.

features.label: the chalk ring
features.inspect_text: A circle of chalk drawn on the cave floor, wide enough to stand in, glowing the pale color of your own marks. It is the largest of its kind you have seen.

descriptions.summary: The chalk ring lies scuffed and broken underfoot. The half-made golems stand unfinished, and there is no hand to finish them now. Only ash, and the cold smoke of an untended fire.

inspect_text: The room stinks of old kill. Fire-scorch runs up the walls; a low flat stone in the middle is black and greasy with a thousand dressings; strips of meat hang from a frame, drying in the smoke. Flies buzz in a corner. Something here was living, and not long ago.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A slab of rock worn black and smooth at its center, where the tribe dresses its kills. The smell is richest here.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.label: the worn crossing tracks
features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: A Glowing Crucible Chamber
summary: A wide pit of white-hot coals throbs with dry, baking heat. The stone walls are glazed red, and the air smells intensely of scorched clay and burned herbs.
inspect_text: Baking heat hits your chest like a wall. A wide stone trough glows with banked, white-hot embers that cast leaping shadows up the jagged ceiling. The air tastes bitter with chalk dust and burned mountain-sage. From the adjacent opening, the rhythm of the staff sounds close enough to touch: TOCK.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A heavy stone trough glowing white and cherry-red, radiating fierce heat that makes the air shimmer.

title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.
inspect_text: Thick predator pelts line the floor, warm from recent bodies. The air is pungent with animal musk and hot grease. Scored into the stone behind the beds are chalk rings and tallies, identical in spacing to the marks on your own knuckles. The staff strikes stone nearby: tock… tock.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Cold Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A low circle of blackened stones holds a bed of sluggish, dying embers. A cold draft from a chimney overhead flattens the smoke, and the room smells of damp soot and wet earth.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: Blackened river stones ringed around grey ash and dying orange coals. The stones are cold to the touch on their outer rim.

title: An Outer Den
summary: A low, drafty alcove where old pelts are piled against damp stone. The smell of cold musk and sour straw hangs in the air, and a small heap of gnawed bird-bones sits in the corner.
inspect_text: You have to stoop. The ceiling drops low over a scatter of moldering hides and stiff furs. A cold seep drips slowly down the back wall, plinking into a stone puddle. In the driest corner, small rodent bones lie arranged in neat little stacks of five—someone here counted them.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A small pile of dry, gnawed bones, sorted by size into neat little bundles.

title: A Scavenge Ground
summary: A cold cavern room littered with splintered bones and dried sinew. A low dressing rock sits under a chimney draft, smelling of old, dried blood and wet slate.
inspect_text: The air is cold and smells of dried sinew and stale blood. A flat limestone slab in the corner is gouged by rough flint scrapers, its surface stained dark. A draft pulls the smell away into high cracks, leaving the chamber stark and quiet.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A flat limestone rock scarred by scraping blades, surrounded by dry shavings of antler and bone.

title: A Guarded Crossing
summary: A golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad, stands in the middle of the room, broad as a closed door, watching nothing. The floor around it is swept clean, and the air is the quietest on this level.
inspect_text: In the center of the room a golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad, stands still as furniture — no mouth, eyes of flat polished pebble, a pale chalk ring circling its chest and brow. It does not react to you. The room smells of cold stone and chalk dust, and small feet have kept clear of it for a long, long time.

features.label: the chalk-ring mark
features.inspect_text: A pale chalk ring is marked on the golem’s chest and brow, in the same pale light as the frost on the sleeping wall.

title: A Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A shallow pit of embers glows in the middle of the floor, ringed with stones scored black by long use. Smoke layers flat against the ceiling like a low roof, and the room is warm enough to sweat in.
inspect_text: Heat meets you at the doorway. A shallow pit of embers throbs low in the center of the room, its ring of stones scarred by a thousand proddings with a fire-stick. The smoke hangs in a flat layer overhead, and your shadow stretches long across the floor. It smells of ash and old grease.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A ring of fire-scarred stones, and inside it embers that never quite die out. The coals breathe, orange and patient.

title: A Den
summary: A low-ceilinged den, thick with old hides and fur. A fire has burned down to ash against one wall, and gnawed bones are stacked neatly in a corner. The air is heavy with damp fur and musk.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A neat stack of long bones, gnawed clean and arranged almost carelessly — the way you’d tidy something you might want again.

title: The Mushroom Grove
summary: A cavern floor is choked with pale mushrooms, all leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air smells of wet earth and something sweet, like crushed fruit.
inspect_text: Pale mushrooms crowd the floor, every cap leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air holds wet earth and something sweet — crushed fruit, or a thing that ripened down here.

features.label: the pale mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Cluster after cluster of knee-high mushrooms sprout from the moist cave soil. Their pale spongy caps all lean uniformly toward the canopy above, as if turning toward a subterranean sun.

features.label: the glowing canopy
features.inspect_text: High above, living roots knit into an expansive vaulted ceiling woven with luminescent lichen and moss. A soft teal glow filters down through the gloom.

title: A Glowing Clearing
summary: A wide clearing lit by drifting spores that pulse slowly, like a heartbeat. Overhead a false sky shimmers, bright enough to read by, wrong enough to notice.
inspect_text: Spores drift across this clearing at a slow, even pulse, lighting the ground beneath your feet. Above, a false sky shimmers faintly — steady enough to read by, wrong enough that you notice.

features.label: the drifting spores
features.inspect_text: Glittering spores drift through the still air in lazy arcs, pulsing brighter and dimmer on an even, four-second cadence like a slow subterranean breath.

features.label: the false sky
features.inspect_text: The cavern ceiling shimmers like an artificial twilight sky. It offers just enough illumination to cast sharp shadows and reveal the path ahead.

title: The Root Tangle
summary: Great roots as thick as your arm weave through the walls here, and between them the forest breathes in and out. Somewhere at the edge of your hearing, something keeps time with it.
inspect_text: Great roots lace the walls and ceiling here, and between them the quiet forest breathes. You listen for a moment; somewhere in the dark, something answers on the same slow rhythm.

features.label: the root tangle

features.label: the living walls
features.inspect_text: Limestone blocks split by ancient wood. Cool water weeps down the fissures, feeding dense coats of dark moss.

title: A Still Pool Glade

features.label: the still pool

features.label: the ripples

title: The Fungus Hollow
summary: Across the hollow, mushrooms stand like sentinels, each near the height of your knee, planted in even ranks. Their caps throw pale light across the stone.
inspect_text: Pale light falls across the hollow from a hundred mushroom caps, each set evenly apart like a field that was planted on purpose. The light is cool and steady, good enough to see by.

features.label: the sentinel mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Stout mushrooms stand in orderly, grid-like rows across the damp earth. Their flat caps cast pale rings of light onto the soil like miniature lanterns.

features.label: the spore light
features.inspect_text: Cool phosphorescence emanating from beneath the mushroom gills, lighting up the soil in quiet pools.

title: A Chalked Trail
summary: Faint chalk lines run along the floor at your feet, worn almost to nothing, leading deeper into the dark. Someone drew a path here long ago and left it.
inspect_text: Thin chalk lines run ahead of you along the stone, worn to ghosts of their old marks. They keep to the center of the passage and lead deeper, as if someone once walked this way often.

features.label: the chalk trail
features.inspect_text: Thin white lines drawn with ancient mineral chalk trace the floor down the center of the lane. They have faded over decades of foot traffic, yet the geometry remains straight and deliberate.

features.label: the worn marks
features.inspect_text: Faint geometric intersections scored into the bedrock. Someone mapped this corridor with precision long before you walked it.

title: The Whispering Ferns
summary: Fern-like growths as tall as your shoulder line the walls, rustling though there is no wind. They whisper in a language that sounds almost familiar.
inspect_text: Tall fern-shaped growths line the walls on both sides, and they murmur without any wind to move them. The sound is almost language, almost your name, never quite either.

features.label: the whispering ferns
features.inspect_text: Towering fronds as tall as your shoulder rustle against each other in dry, rhythmic sibilance. In the rustling you catch fragments that sound uncannily like whispered syllables.

features.label: the rustling sound
features.inspect_text: The fronds move without wind, swaying in gentle synchrony with the breathing of the root-canopy.

title: A Shaft of Sky
summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

title: The Deep Glade
summary: The air here is still and old, and the hum of this forest is loudest at your back. Glowing vines hang around you like curtains, their light slow and steady.
inspect_text: Still, old air lines this glade, and the forest hum is loudest here. Curtains of glowing vine hang heavy around you, their light riding the same slow pulse as the spores of the outer woods.

title: North Approach Plaza
summary: The road ends at a wall. You can see the whole plaza from here: a wide apron of paving where carts turn, steam pipes running the length of it, and the massive iron-and-brass bulkhead of the military fortress filling the far side. Two garrison sentries stand in front of it with their crossbows up, letting nothing past and letting nothing out.
inspect_text: Warm air runs off the pipes along the pylons and the plaza smells like rain on hot iron. Carts have turned on the apron so many times the stone is dished into a curve. There are fresh drag marks across the paving in front of the bulkhead, and a scuff of bright brass where something heavy was dragged and then lifted again. The sentries have not moved. One of them is chewing, and swallowing is the loudest sound on the plaza. You take four steps closer and stop, because there is a point past which one of them would have to do something about you.

features.label: the massive brass bulkhead
features.inspect_text: The bulkhead is banded iron over riveted brass, three spans wide, and it is bolted from the far side. You cannot find a handle anywhere on this face, and you run your hand along the seam anyway. The warm air stops dead at the metal. Somebody has tied a strip of red cloth to a rivet at knee height, and it has faded almost through.

descriptions.summary: The road still ends at the wall, but the plaza is empty now. You can see the whole apron of paving, the steam pipes running its length, and the massive iron-and-brass bulkhead of the military fortress filling the far side. Nothing is standing in front of it.
descriptions.inspect_text: Warm air runs off the pipes along the pylons and the plaza smells like rain on hot iron. The drag marks across the paving have not been washed out. Where the sentries stood there are two patches of flagstone that have not been walked on, and a scatter of brass bolt-heads where the crossbows came apart. Without them the bulkhead is only a wall, and it is a much larger thing to walk up to alone.

title: Clockmaker's Workshop
summary: You hear the workshop before you turn into it. Gears, ticking, and a thin high whine off something escapement-small, all running at once and none of them in the same rhythm.
inspect_text: Tariq has the whole north side open to the drop, so the workshop is lit twice, once by lamps and once by the cavern. Glass cabinets hold calipers, gear trains and timing mechanisms in order, and one drawer is out on the bench with its parts laid out in a line. He keeps looking across the plaza at the fortress pipes and then back at his own work. There is a cup on the bench with a cold skin of tea in it, and a second cup beside it, empty. Both have been sitting there a while. From the north road a cart turns: the wheel noise arrives, and then stops, and nobody comes through the workshop door. You wait to find out.

features.label: the clockwork workbench
features.inspect_text: The bench is scarred with tiny brass swarf and burned at the edges. Loupes, tweezers, a jeweler's saw and four cogwheels sit where he left them, which means he put them down mid-job to go and look at something. You can see where his knee has worn the boards pale. Sketches are pinned above the bench, all the same escapement drawn over and over, each one a little more wrong than the last.

title: Wash Basin Terrace
summary: Everything the village washes goes through here. You hear the terrace before you turn onto it: a long steady run of warm water draining, with the dry scrape of canvas moving in the heat coming off the grates.
inspect_text: Lines of work-shirts and overalls hang shoulder to shoulder over the whole terrace, so much of them that you have to walk underneath. Two of the lines are bare. Somebody took those down early and did not hang them back up, and there are still damp prints on the stones underneath. Warm water runs the length of a limestone gutter and vanishes into a grate. The iron pressure valve is bolted to the riser at the far end, and it ticks as it cools, one tick every few seconds, like something counting.

features.label: communal washing trough
features.inspect_text: The trough is cut from stone and lined with zinc, and it is full to a hand's width of water hot enough to sting. Six wooden pegs are lined up on the near lip. Only four of them are wet, and you find yourself counting the dry ones twice. The scrub brush at the end has its handle worn smooth in one place, exactly where a thumb goes.

features.label: the steam pressure valve
features.inspect_text: A cast-iron wheel at waist height on a brass junction where four pipes meet. You put a hand on the wheel and it turns a quarter turn before it binds, which tells you it is not seized. The rust on the hub is broken away in a band where a gloved hand has been. Turn it the rest of the way and the line pressure vents into the flue at once. It will be loud enough to be heard everywhere on this floor.

title: Water Spring Terrace
summary: Water comes out of the rock here and nowhere else on this floor. You hear it before you see it, a soft steady push into stone basins, and the air over the terrace is cooler than the rest of the village by enough to feel on your arms.
inspect_text: Four stone basins step down the terrace, each one overflowing into the next. Brass canteens are stacked in a row on the lowest lip, and a line of them is still warm. Nafisa works at the top basin with her sleeves pushed up, filling a bucket and then letting it rest on the stone before she moves it, the way you would test a floor you did not trust. Copper pipes overhead bleed off just enough warmth to keep the damp down. From the west a cart wheel grinds over a grate, and somebody calls a number out and gets it wrong.

features.label: the natural stone fountain
features.inspect_text: The spring comes up through a moss-edged hollow in bare limestone, clear enough that you can see the grit on the bottom. The moss is thickest on the side facing away from the pipes, which tells you the water has been running here a good deal longer than the village has.

title: The Village Square
summary: You come down the last step into a broad circle of stone laid in rings, warm under gas lamps somebody keeps filled. The rings are worn pale along a path from the stairs to the hearth, and nobody is standing on that path now.
inspect_text: Broad spiral stone stairs climb back up into the dark you just came out of. A large iron hearth sits at the center, banked low and ticking as it cools, ringed by benches cut into the paving. Flatbread is wrapped in cloth on one bench and has gone cold. Two pairs of small boots are lined up against the hearthstones, and the ash has been raked over them. From the north road you can hear someone moving crates, and a voice counting under its breath. Nobody counts out loud here unless they have forgotten you are standing in the middle.

features.label: the central stone stairs
features.inspect_text: The stairs are cut from one piece of granite, wide enough for four abreast, and worn into shallow bowls where everyone puts their feet going up. You take one of the bowls in your stride without meaning to. The dark at the top has a draft coming down it, hot and dry, that smells of old smoke and hot glass. Somebody has scratched a row of short marks up the second step and stopped halfway.

title: Elder Rashid's Quarters
summary: Books, maps and rolled charts fill every wall, and one heavy desk sits under the window with a lamp still burning on it. Elder Rashid has not moved out of his chair. Two chairs have been pulled up to that desk. Only one of them is occupied, and there is a clean dust ring on the seat of the other where somebody used to sit.
inspect_text: Garrison decrees are stacked under a brass paperweight in one neat pile, and a requisition roll lies open beside them, which tells you he has read it more than once. The window is a slot cut into the rock, too narrow to look out of and too narrow for anything to come in through. From the square you can hear the hearth, and a chair scraping, and then a woman's voice saying a name once and giving up on it.

features.label: the requisition roll
features.inspect_text: A single sheet under Malik's iron seal, demanding one youth from the village and giving a date. Rashid's signature sits at the bottom, gone over so many times the nib has torn the parchment. On the back, in a much younger hand, somebody has written ASK HIM FIRST, and then scratched it out. You read it twice.

title: South Overlook Terrace
summary: The paving stops at a waist-high wall, and past the wall there is nothing at all but dark going down a long way. You stand at the edge and the cavern air comes up past you, cold and moving. It is the only wind on this floor.
inspect_text: Lanterns are hooked along the railing at intervals, and two of them have been turned down to nothing. Kamil is sitting on the wall with his boots hanging over it, counting the ore carts on the rail below and marking each one off on his fingers. He loses his place and starts again. The stone under your hands is polished to a shine in one long strip, worn by a great many people leaning here, none of them in any hurry. Far below and out of sight, a drill comes down on rock four times, waits, and comes down again.

features.label: parapet overlook wall
features.inspect_text: The wall is laid in limestone blocks with scuppers cut through the base to let the wet out, and it has been patched so many times the joints are a patchwork. Along the top the stone is dished into one long shallow groove, and your palm finds it without your looking. That is not weather wearing it down. That is shoulders.

title: Yasmin's Bakery
summary: The oven throws heat out into the street before it reaches you, and with it the smell of sesame and roasted dates, which is the first food smell on this floor. Six flatbreads are cooling on the rack. Yasmin has pulled four of them.
inspect_text: Flour is on the counter, on the floor, and down the front of her apron, and it has been walked through twice. The brick oven is banked and hissing at its door, and the copper coils around its base are furred white with scale. On the counter there is a second bowl of dough, already proved, and a rolling pin set out beside it, and nobody there to use them. Through the doorway the terrace wall ends and the light simply stops going. Somebody has chalked a height mark on the door frame, a second one above it with a date, and a third that has been rubbed out and chalked again a little higher. You put your own hand on the frame to see, and the newest mark is about level with your shoulder.

features.label: the steam-heated oven
features.inspect_text: The hearth is a broad brick dome with steam pipes wrapped around its base, and the fire inside is banked so low you have to look twice to find it. You put your palm flat on the bricks and the heat comes through, even and enormous. There is a shelf of finished loaves going cold on your left, and more going in on your right, and nobody is turning the right-hand side.

title: North Terrace Gardens
summary: The light here comes up out of the plants, so the terrace glows green and blue from the ground up and your own shadow falls the wrong way. Three tiers of planters step up out of the cavern floor, and every one of them has been weeded.
inspect_text: Mushrooms grow in the shade under the lower tier in tight pale rows, and the root vegetables are swelling in the second. The third tier has been replanted and the soil there is still raw. A watering can sits on the rim with its handle turned to stand up on its own, which nobody does on purpose. The moisture trays are all full and none of them are dripping, so whoever filled them came back and checked. The phosphorescence catches on the wet leaves and the whole terrace breathes a little when you walk past. From the square you can hear the hearth being raked.

features.label: phosphorescent planter boxes
features.inspect_text: The planters are carved out of the limestone itself, so the roots have something to grip that will not move. Blue moss fills the gaps between the compost and glows steady enough to read by. Where a plant has been lifted out there is a clean ring of unfaded stone. You count the empty rings. There are four, and none of them have been replanted.

title: Fortress Checkpoint
summary: You are inside the wall now and the temperature drops. The checkpoint is a short steel chamber with barricades zigzagged across it, wire coiled on the racks overhead, and red lamps burning low enough to make everything look like it is happening to somebody else. A drilling machine is grinding across the far end of the floor on iron tracks, and it has not come round to the wire yet.
inspect_text: The floor is steel plate over stone, and the steam conduits run right along the ceiling at head height, close enough to touch. A firing step runs the length of the east wall with the tread worn through in patches and a firing slot at every fourth stone. A heavy hydraulic lever sits in an iron console on the west wall, and the steel rams it drives are visible through a grille: four pins as thick as your arm, all of them pushed home. The lamp buzz is drowned out by the driller, which works its way along the rail with a whine that climbs at the end of every stroke. Its exhaust lays a white haze along the barricades and the rails go on straight under it, which means somebody sent it this way and did not think about the wire. Through the floor, you can hear the dynamos turning over on the other side.

features.label: the hydraulic gate lever
features.inspect_text: The lever is brass on iron, worn to bright metal along the grip. Somebody has scratched a tally into the console beside it and stopped at nine. You put your palm on the pin housing and it is still warm. Whatever last ran through this, the pressure has not been off the lines long.

title: West Iron Walkway
summary: The walkway is bolted to the rock and barely a body's width, and the drop on your left goes down far enough that you cannot see the bottom of it. It quivers when you step. Overhead the copper pipes are wet with condensation, and it comes down the back of your neck in one slow line. A garrison sentry is pacing the grating at the far end with a steam bayonet fixed to a carbine.
inspect_text: Steam comes up through cracks in the rock below. It is cold where the steam is not, so you walk through cold and warm in stretches of about four paces. Hot water drips off the brackets in a regular pattern and lands on the mesh, and every drop lands in the same place long enough to have worn a bright spot through it. The bolts at the anchor points are crusted with old scale, which means this has been standing here longer than the garrison has. Below and to the left, the rock face is polished pale where ore carts have run close under you. The sentry walks the same six paces and turns at the same bracket every time, and on the third pass he misses the loose plate entirely and catches himself on the rail. He is the only set of boots on this walkway and he has been up here a while. You count his passes before you decide what to do.

features.label: overhead steam pipes
features.inspect_text: Four pipes clamped to the rock on steel brackets, two of them sweating and one hissing. A joint at head height has been re-banded in clean copper against old rust, so somebody has been up here after something started leaking. The clamp nearest you is loose enough to rock by hand. It would hold your weight. You would rather not find out by standing on it.

title: Suspended Steam Cage
summary: The cage hangs from four chains over a vent throwing heat up hard enough to make the air wobble. You can hear the vent breathing. The bars are black with soot and hot on the side nearest the rock, and the boy inside has backed himself into the far corner where it is cooler.
inspect_text: A single iron walkway rings the pit, and the winch that controls the cage is bolted into the granite with its handle padlocked. Four chains go up into the dark, all four taut, and all four stretched before: they are thinner at the links where they turn. A rope ends in a loop on the walkway rail at the height of a child's chest, worn smooth. Below, the vent breathes in and out and the light coming up off it is orange and unsteady. Zayd has his coat pulled tight around one fist and is not looking at the heat. The warden has not sat down at all. You can tell where his weight has worn the flagstones.

features.label: the suspended iron cage
features.inspect_text: Iron bars, close enough together that you could not get a hand through, and a floor of the same. The brass padlock on the gate is good work and has no keyhole big enough to pick. The chains are greased, and grease means somebody does this on purpose. Under the floor the cage swings a little with every breath out of the vent, always the same direction, always the same inch.

descriptions.summary: The cage still hangs from four chains over the vent, but nobody is standing on the walkway. The winch handle is loose in its housing, and the boy has moved to the front of the cage where he can see out through the bars.
descriptions.inspect_text: The vent breathes in and out and the light coming up off it is orange and unsteady. Where the warden was standing there is one worn patch of flagstone and a ring of ration tins nobody collected. The winch console stands open, the locking bar lifted and left hanging. Zayd has both hands on the cage door and is not touching the padlock yet, as though he has decided he is finished waiting and is waiting to see if anyone agrees with him.

title: South Steam Gantry
summary: This corridor runs between the boilers and it is the hottest part of the complex. The vapor comes up out of the floor grates in slow rolling sheets, so you walk into a wall of it every twenty paces and out the far side of it. An ore hauler is coming down the corridor on the rails, and it is between you and the south door.
inspect_text: The dynamos along the north wall are turning over, and you can feel each one in your teeth. A bank of round gauges runs the length of the south wall, and every needle in the row is sitting in the same band, ticking together, which means the whole floor is running on one pressure. A rivet line on the ceiling is weeping. Somebody has caught the drip in a flat tin, and the tin has been emptied twice today. Far off down the corridor a door bangs and swings, and this time you can see what opened it: an ore hauler coming up the rails with its scoops down, throwing sparks off the plate in a rhythm that matches the gauges exactly. It is not slowing down for you and it is not speeding up either. You have about as long as it takes to decide.

features.label: brass pressure gauges
features.inspect_text: Round glass faces in brass housings, and behind the glass the needles sit in a tight band and never stray from it. The lowest gauge in the row is painted round the rim in red, and its needle is just inside the paint. There is a date scratched into the housing beside it, and a set of initials. Under the gauges the wall is scorched in a long strip, and the paint there has blistered and peeled away in flakes. You could read the initials if you stepped closer, and you decide not to.

title: Commander's Bastion
summary: The room is built for a meeting, not for a war. A brass tactical table fills the center under a low lamp with the floor around it left clear for standing. Racks of weapons line two walls, all of them polished. You are two steps inside the doorway before anything in the room moves.
inspect_text: The tactical table is a model of this whole floor cut into the brass, and it is kept up to date. There is chalk dust in the gutters of it and a fresh score in two places. Red silk banners hang between the steam vents, and one of them has a burn through the lower corner. Along the third wall, armor stands hold six sets of dress brass, and four of the stands are empty. The safe is set into the granite under a low lamp of its own, with its own little light and its own clean patch of floor. Through the wall, you can hear the platform humming.

features.label: the commander's iron safe
features.inspect_text: An iron body with brass dials and reinforced hinges, bolted through the stone rather than into it. There is a clean rectangle in the dust on the floor in front of it, the size of somebody kneeling. The tumblers are well used and the brass around them is bright where hands have gone. You try to imagine the combination and there are too many ways to be wrong.

descriptions.summary: The room is still built for a meeting, and the meeting is over. The brass tactical table sits under its low lamp with the floor around it clear. Malik is on the flagstones and not moving, and nobody else in the room is moving either.
descriptions.inspect_text: Chalk dust in the gutters of the tactical table, and the two fresh scores in it are where a hand stopped. One of the red silk banners has come down off its vent and lies across the corner of the table. The hydraulic rams behind the grille have gone back into the wall with a bang you can still hear in the walls. The safe sits under its own lamp with its own clean patch of floor, and the lamp is still burning, and nothing is standing between you and it.

title: East Sentry Rampart
summary: A steel rampart two carts wide runs along the eastern face, and three searchlights on tripods are all aimed at the same patch of empty courtyard below. You look for what they are watching and there is nothing down there to watch. One sentry is up here anyway, working the same empty ground with a brass spyglass.
inspect_text: The bolt cradles along the parapet are full. Spent crossbow bolts lie by the guard benches with their fletching chewed off, and a ration tin sits unopened on a bench arm. On the underside of the rampart, forty names are scratched into the stone in four neat columns, and the fourth column has been gone over so often the numbers are hard to make out. A duty roster is nailed to the post by the ladder. Tonight's names are crossed out in chalk. There is no second shift written underneath, and the sentry at the ladder is the only man still up here, which means the chalk is either already true or about to be. Below and to the south, the platform glows up through the security grille, pale turquoise, steady as a held breath. He has the spyglass up and the courtyard is empty in it, and when he lowers it he does not look surprised. He looks tired, and he goes back to watching. You step into the searchlight and do the arithmetic: three lights, one man, and nothing on the roster under his name.

features.label: brass searchlight mount
features.inspect_text: A brass searchlight on a tripod, fed by its own heavy steam conduit, with the reflector lens angled down and away. There is no shutter and no hood, so it burns the same all night regardless of what walks into it. The tripod feet are sunk into the steel and the bolts have been backed off and retightened more than once. On the housing somebody has scratched a child's height mark and a date, and then scratched the date out. Your hand is bigger than the mark. You know it, and you look at it anyway.

title: Teleportation Platform
summary: The courtyard is sunk below the level of everything around it, and the brass platform in the middle is the lowest thing you have stood on since you came down here. It is pulsing. Not fast, and not in time with your breathing, and it has been pulsing the whole time you have been on this floor.
inspect_text: Copper lines come in under the ground from every direction and all of them meet the ring. Relief valves let off steam in rhythm, and the steam goes up and is gone before it reaches the walls. The stone here is basalt, scorched in a wide ring where the steam has been coming up for years. There are boot prints in the ash, hundreds of them, all going the same way. From the north you can hear the rampart you came in by, and further off, faintly, someone hammering something in the village, which you would not hear at all if the platform were not so quiet.

features.label: the circular brass teleport platform
features.inspect_text: A brass disc, wider than your arms are long, cut with two triangles that cross and a circle drawn round the crossing. The metal is warm, and it is not the geothermal heat making it warm. Where boots have worn it the brass is bright; at the rim it is still black with scale, and the scale rings the edge in clean steps, showing the water rising and falling over years. The geometry is the same one your chalk draws. It was not always the size of a room. It has been added to.

title: The Frost Courtyard
summary: A colossal hexagonal courtyard paved in frost-rimed stone, enclosed by towering fortress walls under a cold purple sky. In the center hums a wide brass teleport platform—the citadel's sole link across the dimensional divide to Floor 4. Nearby stand rows of heavy iron cages marked with white block codes, packing shivering civilians into the freezing wind.
inspect_text: High battlements hem in the six-sided courtyard, backed by sheer abyss and mountain rock. No physical stair, ramp, or shaft connects this citadel to the floors above; only the glowing brass platform bridges the gap via teleportation. Howling wind whips snow across the flags and through the bars of four mass offering cages. Sentry posts look down from the ramparts, and six stone archways connect to the surrounding approaches and defensive chokepoints.

features.label: the brass teleport platform
features.inspect_text: A broad circular brass dais inlaid with geometric conduits. It pulses with pale turquoise energy, serving as the sole teleportation anchor linking this isolated citadel back to the Floor 4 platform. Without any physical connection between floors, stepping onto the transit circuit and using teleport is the only way back.

features.label: the offering cages
features.inspect_text: Four heavy iron cages labeled BLOCK 01, BLOCK 04, BLOCK 07, and BLOCK 12. Shivering elderly commoners and frightened children peer through the frosted bars. A massive padlocked gate keeps them sealed inside.

title: The Frost-Wolf Approach
summary: The northern avenue of the courtyard, flanked by fluted marble pillars hung with deep navy banners bearing a howling silver wolf. To the north rises the frost-caked archway into House Frost-Wolf Manor.
inspect_text: Snow drifts against the bases of the pillars. The silver wolf crest gleams on heavy navy silk. Ahead, heavy spiked iron gates seal the entrance to the Frost-Wolf estate.

features.label: the wolf banners
features.inspect_text: Banners of heavy navy silk bearing the snarling silver wolf crest of House Frost-Wolf.

features.label: the Frost-Wolf manor gate
features.inspect_text: A massive spiked gate of black iron and rime frost, barring passage into House Frost-Wolf Manor. It is barred from within.

title: The North-East Rampart
summary: An elevated stone battlement along the fortress curtain wall. Freezing gales rush up from sheer mountain ravines far below. Broad stone crenels form a natural defensive chokepoint.
inspect_text: Thick granite crenels provide solid cover against incoming fire. The stones are slick with rime ice, overlooking a terrifying drop into the abyss.

features.label: the stone crenels
features.inspect_text: Thick granite crenels providing solid cover against incoming missile fire and funneling attackers into a narrow breach.

title: The Iron-Ram Approach
summary: The southeastern wing of the courtyard paved with soot-stained iron flags. Heavy crimson and charcoal banners emblazoned with a horned ram's skull hang above roaring steam flues. To the east looms the fortified portcullis into House Iron-Ram Bastion.
inspect_text: Steam hisses constantly from brass grates set into the floor, melting the falling snow into grey slush. To the east, a massive iron-toothed portcullis seals the entrance to the Iron-Ram Bastion.

features.label: the ram banners
features.inspect_text: Banners of coarse crimson wool displaying the horned iron ram skull over cross-hammers.

features.label: the Iron-Ram portcullis
features.inspect_text: A three-ton portcullis of interlocking forged iron teeth, dropped firmly in place to seal the bastion entrance.

title: The South Fortress Gate
summary: The southern defensive bottleneck of the citadel. A pair of colossal banded-iron fortress doors seal the courtyard against the frozen mountain pass outside. Heavy barricades of reinforced timber narrow the path into a brutal killing zone.
inspect_text: Huge iron timbers block the southern gates, encrusted in frost. Defensive murder holes and reinforced palisades funnel any attack into a tight chokepoint.

features.label: the fortress doors
features.inspect_text: Enormous gates of banded iron and mountain oak, reinforced by heavy crossbars. They stand closed against the howling blizzard outside.

title: The Frost-Leopard Approach
summary: The southwestern avenue of the courtyard where frost-crusted colonnades display ash-grey banners of a leaping snow leopard. To the west, ornate frosted glass and wrought-iron doors open into House Frost-Leopard Hall.
inspect_text: The colonnade is lined with delicate frosted glass lanterns. Ash-grey banners bearing the snow leopard crest rustle in the freezing mountain wind. The glass conservatory doors to the west are locked tight.

features.label: the leopard banners
features.inspect_text: Silken ash-grey banners with ice-blue trim, portraying a snarling snow leopard mid-leap.

features.label: the conservatory doors
features.inspect_text: Heavy wrought-iron conservatory doors fitted with frosted glass panels, bolted from inside House Frost-Leopard Hall.

title: The North-West Parapet
summary: A narrow catwalk skirting the outer fortress wall between the courtyard and the mountain precipice. Cold wind swirls snow across the flags, and a narrow stone stair connects the rampart to the courtyard below.
inspect_text: A narrow, single-file walkway along the battlements. Any force attempting to cross here must march in a narrow column, making it ideal for defense.

features.label: the stone catwalk
features.inspect_text: A narrow, single-file walkway along the battlements. Any force attempting to cross here must march in a narrow column, making it ideal for defense.

title: The Great Wolf Gallery
summary: A grand, frost-rimed colonnade of pale blue stone hung with massive naval-blue banners bearing the silver wolf of House Frost-Wolf. Braziers of blue witchfire burn in iron baskets, throwing long, flickering shadows against fluted pillars.
inspect_text: Howling wind sweeps down the long corridor from the north. The floor is paved in slabs of dark basalt veined with turquoise frost. Carvings of snarling wolves and huntsmen decorate the frieze above.

features.label: the witchfire braziers
features.inspect_text: Iron baskets filled with cold-burning blue witchfire. They emit intense light with virtually no warmth, casting the long gallery in pale twilight.

title: The Wolfguard Muster
summary: A wide vaulted muster hall and drill armory. Racks of heavy frost-axes, spiked spears, and heavy hide pavises line the walls. Wolf pelts drape the weapon benches, and the air smells of weapon grease, rime frost, and mountain cedar.
inspect_text: This is the staging hall where House Frost-Wolf's vanguard prepares for combat. Heavy weapon chests sit bolted to the flagstones, and training dummies of packed snow and bound wicker stand notched from axe strikes.

features.label: the weapon racks
features.inspect_text: Sturdy iron stands holding notched frost-axes and spiked heater shields bearing the wolf crest.

exits.label: South to the Great Wolf Gallery
exits.menu_label: South to the Great Wolf Gallery

title: The Howling Dais
summary: The high inner sanctum of House Frost-Wolf. At the northern apex, a colossal throne carved from a single jagged block of glacier ice rises atop tiered stone steps. Above the dais, massive arched skylights look out onto the shrieking blizzard.
inspect_text: Runic glyphs etched in deep cobalt pulse across the glacial throne. Heavy wolf furs cover the frozen seat, and cold steam curls from the cracks in the surrounding dais.

features.label: the glacial throne
features.inspect_text: A towering throne of ancient compressed glacier ice, surrounded by cold mist and wolf trophies.

title: The Steam Flue Corridor
summary: A reinforced industrial corridor of riveted bronze plates and heavy iron braces. Overhead conduits hiss with pressurized geothermal steam, and crimson and charcoal banners emblazoned with a horned ram's skull shudder in the rising heat.
inspect_text: Steam rises through slotted floor grates, keeping the corridor stiflingly warm despite the freezing altitude outside. Brass gauges and steam release wheels are mounted along the basalt walls.

features.label: the steam pipes
features.inspect_text: Heavy insulated copper and bronze conduits delivering geothermal steam from the citadel boilers.

title: The Bastion Muster
summary: An industrial assembly hall and siege armory. Heavy hydraulic cranes, ammunition hoists, and racks of curved pavise shields flank the wide central corridor where Iron-Ram shock troopers muster for battle.
inspect_text: The floor is stained with black engine soot and machine grease. Racks of barbed poleaxes and steam-assisted siege rams stand ready along the fortified bulkhead.

features.label: the hydraulic cranes
features.inspect_text: Pneumatic winches designed to lift heavy iron plates and barricade balks into place across the bastion.

title: The Anvil Throne
summary: The martial command seat of House Iron-Ram. Built atop a raised stepped dais of slag-cast black iron sits a forge-hammered throne, framed by roaring blast chimneys that cast an intense fiery glow over the soot-streaked flags.
inspect_text: A massive steel horn crest arches over the throne back. Hydraulic pressure lines pulse beneath the metal plates of the dais, and a massive war table displays iron markers of the citadel defenses.

features.label: the anvil throne
features.inspect_text: A colossal chair forged from dark cast iron and tempered steel, shaped like a horn-crowned anvil.

title: The Frosted Colonnade
summary: A soaring vaulted gallery flanked by slender pillars of ash-grey marble and lit by frosted crystal lanterns. Banners of pale slate silk embroidered with leaping snow leopards drape the walls beside tall lancet windows overlooking the sheer abyss.
inspect_text: A dusting of powdery snow blows in through high stone tracery. The floor is paved in honed quartz that mirrors the pale violet sky outside with crystalline precision.

features.label: the crystal lanterns
features.inspect_text: Delicate geometric lanterns of faceted frost-glass containing soft, self-illuminating white crystals.

title: The Shadow Promenade
summary: An opulent, silent muster hall paved in polished grey quartz. Mirrored alcoves and silk-screened partitions conceal training duels and weapon chests filled with curved ice-daggers, silent composite recurves, and throwing quills.
inspect_text: Every step is muffled by thick fur runners. Concealed spy-holes and acoustic resonance tubes throughout the colonnade allow the Leopard guard to survey the avenue without being seen.

features.label: the mirrored alcoves
features.inspect_text: Deep niches set with frosted mirrors that reflect light at disorienting angles, concealing sentry positions.

title: The Opal Throne
summary: The serene, perilous inner sanctum of House Frost-Leopard. Carved from a massive boulder of iridescent opal and polished silver, the throne rests upon a dais of dark velvet stone, commanding a sweeping view through tall open arches across the frozen mountains.
inspect_text: Silver threads and frost-glass chimes hang from the high ceiling, chiming softly in the freezing alpine wind. The opal throne glimmers with shifting hues of lavender, mint, and pale gold.

features.label: the opal throne
features.inspect_text: An exquisite throne carved from shimmering glacial opal, cold as winter glass and cushioned in snow-leopard pelts.

title: The High Sanctuary Gate
summary: Beyond the opened south doors, a steep covered passage drops through the mountain toward a white stone gate. Warm air rises through its bars, carrying clean herbs, lamp smoke, and distant bells from Floor 6.
inspect_text: The Citadel's last portcullis stands raised. Beyond it, pale stairs descend toward the High Sanctuary. The route is open, but the worker towns now shining on the teleport map can still be visited before you leave.

features.label: the raised portcullis
features.inspect_text: The iron teeth hang above the passage. The command lock is dark, and nothing remains to close the gate again.

title: Salt Reach Landing
summary: A low town of dark timber and blue-grey stone stands beside white brine fields. Wind pushes loose salt over the road like dry snow while families cut clear blocks from the frozen pools.
inspect_text: The teleport seal rests in a brass socket beside a warm storehouse. Sled tracks run toward the brine pans, and rows of drying fish hang under deep roofs built to survive the polar wind.

features.label: the frozen brine pans
features.inspect_text: Workers cut neat slabs from shallow mineral pools. Blue ice shows beneath a crust of clean white salt.

title: Glassbank Furnace Square
summary: Brick workshops ring a square lit orange by furnace doors. Glass lamps in cobalt, amber, and green hang above the street, turning the snow into pools of colored light.
inspect_text: The teleport prism stands in a steel frame near the public lens shop. Long brick chimneys breathe into the cold while glass workers carry glowing rods between the furnaces.

features.label: the signal lamps
features.inspect_text: Each lamp uses a different cut of glass to send a clear color through snow and fog.

title: Woolcross Loom Court
summary: Stone homes climb a sheltered slope around a broad weaving court. Bright woven cloth covers the rails, and thick ropes stretch between workshops built against the mountain wind.
inspect_text: The copper transit knot is fixed beside a communal loom house. Families sort wool, twist climbing rope, and carry folded winter cloth through the busy court.

features.label: the community looms
features.inspect_text: Heavy wooden looms beat in a steady rhythm as red, gold, and deep blue threads become warm mountain cloth.

title: Greenrest Garden Cavern
summary: Warm cave air carries the smell of wet soil and herbs. Homes and garden beds fill a wide glowing cavern where mushrooms rise beneath hanging lamps.
inspect_text: The enamel transit seed rests in a living wall of roots near the market. Growers move between raised beds of medicine plants, mushrooms, and dark leafy vegetables.

features.label: the medicine gardens
features.inspect_text: Carefully labeled beds hold bitter leaves, pale mushrooms, and warming roots used by the town's healers.

title: Brass Yard Machine Court
summary: A crowded machine town fills a stone basin with pumps, cranes, repair sheds, and narrow homes. Brass signs click in the wind while steam rolls across the paving stones.
inspect_text: The transit gear turns slowly inside a wall-mounted routing clock. Mechanics test valves at open benches, and handcarts carry broken parts toward workshops bright with clean white lamps.

features.label: the repair benches
features.inspect_text: Every bench holds labeled trays of screws, gears, seals, and careful drawings for machines used across the worker towns.
